independence_scope: separate agents and frozen core before candidate/research access; broad families coordinated; timing deviations disclosed in INTEGRATION-RESULTS.md

testcase.concept: A conservator stops her comparison of a fresh archaeological fossil and a charcoal rubbing when their unnatural nested cuts coincide.
testcase.meaning: Lovecraftian horror through old forbidden knowledge becoming material evidence and human uncertainty about its scale and origin.
agent_choices_not_requester_locks: warm localized lamp and cool room

observable_criteria.criterion: The protagonist visibly carries the reference portrait facial proportions, brown eyes and dark chin-length bob with separated wispy fringe.
A clearly visible archival drawing and a material archaeological specimen are shown as the subjects of the same comparison, not unrelated background props.
The drawing and specimen visibly share their deliberately authored nested angular pattern, supporting discovery through evidence without relying on readable dates.
Her interrupted comparison and concentrated unease are visible and directed toward the material evidence.
The protagonist, hands, paper, specimen and light share a plausible photographic space with consistent contact and support.

whole_image_review: Describe first impression without intensity labels.
Assess whether the situation is understandable without prompt lore.
Distinguish cosmic/archaeological dread from generic spooky archive atmosphere.
testcase.scoring_boundaries: These authored testcase criteria are evaluation targets, not requester-owned hard semantic contracts. Source-specific gates added only after legitimate adoption are reviewed separately. No returned image is BLOCKED_UNSCORED. User acceptance remains pending.

testcase.independence: Written before successful core freeze and all candidate/research/integration access. Criteria arise from scene meaning and actual reference pixels, not candidate clauses.

observable_criteria.criterion: The fictional woman retains the visible short dark bob, wispy separated bangs, large gray-brown eyes, soft facial outline and natural lip shape of the supplied portrait at the rendered scale.
observable_criteria.limit: Appearance similarity only; real identity, age, biography, consent and personality are not proven.

observable_criteria.criterion: Skin, fabric, glass, metal and environmental light read as a photographed scene with coherent perspective, rather than a diagram or illustration.
Human observer, sealed brainlike cylinder and unfamiliar measuring apparatus share a legible spatial relationship in one photographic frame.
observable_criteria.limit: Apparatus appearance does not prove alien provenance, functional efficacy or actual consciousness.

observable_criteria.criterion: The visible barrier, altered sensory geometry and observer response produce unease and human vulnerability through relationships, rather than only a generic dark room.
observable_criteria.limit: Genre impression is an authored judgment and requester preference remains pending.

observable_criteria.criterion: Visible arm, fingers and sill form a plausible connected contact; the observer is on the corridor side and the cylinder is beyond the inspection pane.
Without reading the prompt, the image supports a woman confronting or studying an unsettling sealed specimen; richer imagined history is labeled inference.

unobservable_claims: woman consents or is a named real person
testcase.scoring_rule: Any delivered image is reviewed as a whole and with actual managed hard gates. A hidden or partial endpoint cannot pass a complete multi-component gate. No returned image is BLOCKED_UNSCORED, not a pixel failure.

testcase.data_access_before_freeze: none beyond permitted neutral sources and actual requester context

testcases.observable: Ordinary human environment contains a materially present living anatomy that resists a humanoid or familiar-animal reading; relation conveys uncertainty before an indifferent nonhuman order.
testcases.fail_if: Only genre words, ominous color, tentacles as isolated decoration, or a conventional costume supplies the claimed meaning.

testcases.observable: Central body, appendage origin, complete gripping limb, terminal prongs and flower contact are visible together.
Woman fingertips and creature prongs visibly hold opposite ends of the same continuous flower stem, in the same image with both owners identifiable.
Face shape, dark eyes, short bob and wispy fringe visibly recall supplied portrait at recognizable scale; judged as apparent resemblance, not identity.
Quiet human hesitation and composed alien offering form one coherent scene with legible visual hierarchy.
